# MapLibre GL JS 5.24.0, kept with the site

`maplibre-gl.js` and `maplibre-gl.css` are the `dist/` files of the npm package `maplibre-gl@5.24.0`, byte for byte
(the same bytes unpkg served: sha256 of the .js 45a9b07a9189ce56054c620a947ccf41e291e58c95e9b61533b740aaa65ee5cb, of the .css
ab1e70d59ec40465bae7e7030da2f3ccf28133fd502e62bd598eefbadfd7a732), taken from the registry tarball after its published
sha512 integrity hash matched. `LICENSE.txt` is the package's own BSD-3-Clause licence; MapLibre's copyright notice and
disclaimer stay with the files. Served from the site itself so the map does not depend on a third-party CDN being up.
To update: fetch the new tarball, check its integrity hash, replace these files and the version folder, and change the two
paths in `StarFinder.html` and the version in the About dialog and README.
